notes.title: Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
This update includes the following fixes and improvements:

[list]
[*] [b]Camera Shooting Bug[/b]: Fixed a bug where the camera would show an empty area when zooming.
[*] [b]Camera Zoom Addition[/b]: Added a camera zoom mode.
[*] [b]BGM Addition[/b]: Added background music to the title screen and during gameplay.
[*] [b]Character Control Explanation Addition[/b]: Added an explanation about character jumping.
[/list]

notes.title: Game Update - Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
This update includes the following fixes and improvements:

* [b]Gold Orb Count Bug[/b]: Addressed an issue where the gold orb count was not displaying correctly.
* [b]Checkpoint Explanation[/b]: Added a checkpoint explanation to the How to Play section.
* [b]Rendering Performance[/b]: Optimized several elements that were causing high rendering load, resulting in improved performance, especially on lower-end hardware.
